messages:
Sam: Quick update from HK-Supply — 18 of 80 H100s in the current allocation are held in FRA customs; forwarder estimates 48–72h to clear unless we pay for pre-clearance. Options: air-expedite for ~30 units (adds ~$350/unit + quicker ETA 12–24h), pull 30 EU loaners from the pool (no surcharge, 7-day loan), or accept sea reroute (2–3w). Need decision for provisioning and customer commitments.
Maria: Ugh. Which customers are on the 30 we’d expedite? Can we prioritize by committed SLA?
Josh: @Maria — list attached in the ops sheet, short version: 18 for Dedicated customers (high SLA), 12 for internal staging, rest for general pool. If we expedite 30 we keep all Dedicated happy.
Li: If we move 30 loaners from EU pool, what's downstream impact? We have 10 scheduled edge launches next week that assume those loaners.
Kai: Edge launches can be shifted by 48–72h, not ideal but manageable. Main risk is burst capacity for batch jobs Friday morning.
Sam: Cost math quick: air-expedite 30 * $350 = $10.5k extra. Loaners: operational cost negligible but blockers for edges. Sea reroute saves money but breaks timelines. Any other creative moves?
Josh: We could pair: expedite 18 (cover Dedicated) and pull 12 loaners to cover staging — that splits the delta and keeps extra cost ~6.3k.
Maria: That sounds reasonable. Confirm that the loaner pool after the 12 pull still leaves us >= min pool for emergency allocations.
Josh: Pool will be at 18 units after the pull; min safe is 12, so we have a 6-unit buffer.
vendor_ops_bot: RMA created for FRA hold: RMA-9231. Forwarder AWBs: ``AWB: 123-45678901, 123-45678902``. Bot note: ETA to release with pre-clearance = 12–24h; without = 48–72h.
Li: If we do the partial expedite, someone needs to own the return flow for temporary loaners — labels, RMAs, and tracking. Volunteering: I can coordinate returns and paperwork.
Sam: Thanks @Li. Assigning decision for direction: @Maria ok to approve partial expedite (18 units) + 12 loaners move? We need thumbs by EOD.
Maria: :thumbsup: Approve partial expedite + loaner pull. Please document costs for finance.
Josh: Will book air slots now and update the ops sheet. Creating PO amendment for expedite fee, tagging finance.
Kai: I'll reschedule the edge launches by 48h and notify product owners.
vendor_ops_bot: PO amendment created: PO-55821 (expedite fees). RMA-9231 updated with AWB hold reason: missing commercial invoice field "consignee_eori" — vendor asked customs broker to submit.
Sam: Also flag: if broker can't submit consignee_eori today, fallback plan is full seizure risk — we need to notify two Dedicated customers about probable 72h delay. I'll draft copy.
Li: I'll prepare return-label kit and hold a pickup window for loaners returning in 7 days.
Maria: Finance: expect a one-time expedite charge ~ $6.3k (we split expedite for 18 units) + internal ops overhead. Please confirm accounting code.
Josh: Filed under INF-GPU-EXPEDITE. I'll attach receipts.
Sam: Good work team. Keep this thread updated — post AWB release or any customs notes here.
Maria: Also, quick ask: can procurement negotiate future allocations with HK-Supply for earlier pre-clearance to avoid repeat? If we commit to quarterly buys maybe waive pre-clearance fee.
Josh: On it — I'll open negotiation thread with vendor next week and push for pre-clearance addendum.
vendor_ops_bot: Update: customs broker submitted consignee_eori at 1764202600, hold lifted for AWB 123-45678901. Remaining AWB 123-45678902 pending.
Sam: Nice. Keep eyes on the second AWB. If it clears we can cancel the second partial expedite.
Li: Noted — I'll stand down on return labels until final status.
Josh: Final note — documenting decision in post-provisioning runbook so ops oncall knows the fallback ladder for future FRA holds.
Maria: Thanks. End of thread for now — followups as they come.
